mods.name: Coherent R&D
mods.author: Mordachai
mods.shortDescription: Makes the component families in empire policies work the way they read. Adds the families to XL's armor, shields, engines, hyperdrives and reactors, lets an empire that prefers a family still use a clearly better component outside it, and fixes the game's hyperdrive efficiency score. Load it after DW2-XL.

mods.name: Diplomatic Corps
mods.author: Mordachai
mods.shortDescription: Diplomacy you control: you decide which treaties each kind of relationship may have, racial and government ceilings limit who becomes an ally, and the AI picks its friends with discipline.

mods.name: DLC Compatibility for XL
mods.author: Mordachai
mods.shortDescription: Makes DLC content fit XL without XL needing the DLC. Today: Shadows Rising pirate hulls get XL's bay sizes, so their smallest ships stop fitting the biggest armor.

mods.name: DW2R-Flags
mods.author: salemonz
mods.shortDescription: Hundreds of new flags for every race, and AI empires that actually fly them. Plus a flag picker that shows them all and a way to change any empire's flag mid-game.

mods.name: DW2R-Ground-Units
mods.author: salemonz
mods.shortDescription: Every race's ground troops in full color, a readable ground combat screen, and a clearer colony troop panel.

mods.name: DW2R-Lighting
mods.author: salemonz
mods.shortDescription: Ships lit by their star: a bright side and a dark side, real shadows on the hull, and filmic color. Inspired by EVE Online.

mods.name: DW2R-Resources
mods.author: salemonz
mods.shortDescription: Replaces the default Resource art assets with new images and colored backgrounds for easier reference.

mods.name: DW2R-Shipset-Colors
mods.author: salemonz
mods.shortDescription: Four new colors for every shipset, chosen per empire. Pick your ship color at new game setup, and AI empires fly their own colors too.

mods.name: Freighter Logistics
mods.author: Mordachai
mods.shortDescription: Some runtime tweaks to freighter logistics to make them work a bit better

mods.name: Galactic Genesis
mods.author: Mordachai
mods.shortDescription: Rebalances nebulas so that they don't completely destroy logistics and ship range

mods.name: Independence Day
mods.author: Mordachai
mods.shortDescription: Makes independent colonies worth having: new games can start with none, independents are always armed and grow stronger defences, and a colony that becomes a new empire gets a real start.

mods.name: Music Box
mods.author: Mordachai
mods.shortDescription: Adds a mini music player control to the game, plus volume control, and choices as to when to play your music or game-mood-music

mods.name: Positronic Matrix
mods.author: Mordachai
mods.shortDescription: Gives other code mods a safe place to keep their data in your saved game, so a choice or a record survives save and load.

mods.name: Settings Keeper
mods.author: Mordachai
mods.shortDescription: Keeps your game settings, key bindings, default policy and new-game setup in plain text files outside the game folder, so a game update or a Steam branch switch no longer resets them.

mods.name: Ship Logistics
mods.author: Mordachai
mods.shortDescription: A whole gamut of changes to make fleets and ships behave more intelligently

mods.name: Spies Have Limits
mods.author: Mordachai
mods.shortDescription: Spies Have Limits gives you the player more control over how they work in game.

mods.name: Tactical Savvy
mods.author: Mordachai
mods.shortDescription: Makes ships fight more sensibly. Ships hold fire until the target is well inside weapon range instead of firing from the edge of range, and fighters and bombers fight from closer still.

mods.name: Translation Core - Japanese
mods.author: Mordachai
mods.shortDescription: Japanese Translation of DW2

mods.name: Translation Pack - Japanese
mods.author: Mordachai
mods.shortDescription: Translation Pack for Mordchai's Mods

mods.name: Translation Pack - Russian
mods.author: Mordachai
mods.shortDescription: Translation Pack for Mordchai's Mods

mods.name: Troop Logistics
mods.author: Mordachai
mods.shortDescription: Troops stay where they are needed: garrisons that scale with population and stay put, idle transports that stop hoarding troops, and reserves staged near your invasion fleets.

mods.name: War Chest
mods.author: Mordachai
mods.shortDescription: Protect your reserves. Control your spending. Keep the empire ready for anything. One treasury floor and one view of income and upkeep that every XL mod asks before it spends.

mods.name: XL
mods.author: Mordachai
mods.shortDescription: eXpands and enLarges the game - tech tree, weapons, engines, reactors, sensors, etc.

mods.shortDescription: Translation of XL's own text
